verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's own docs say it can load data from object storage and query S3, GCS and Azure Blob directly, with S3 credentials stored as SECRET objects. That covers the core of ingesting from cloud storage. The pack, however, never names the CSV, JSON and Parquet formats or shows a single bulk-load command. missing for 10: an explicitly documented single load command (e.g. a CREATE TABLE AS / COPY example), confirmed coverage of the CSV, JSON and Parquet formats, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk-load behavior.
